note: The launcher's update channel (docs/UPDATES.md). EMPTY in this release: no channel and no trusted key, so 'Check for updates' only says that no update channel is configured and nothing is contacted. The maintainer fills channel (id + github_repo OWNER/NAME or url https://...) and trusted_keys (the 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA...' line of the release signing key) for published releases (docs/OWNER_UPDATE_CHANNEL.md). Checks run only when you ask; an upstream Takedawn repository is never accepted as a channel.
